question: Two identical circles intersect each other such that each passes through the centre of the other. Length of common chord is 16sqrt{3} cm. What is the radius of each circle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
When two **identical circles** pass through each other's **centers**, the length of the **common chord** is given by **r√3**.

Given: Common chord = 16√3 cm

⇒ r√3 = 16√3

⇒ r = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Two circles are **identical**, so Radius **r₁ = r₂ = R**.

⇒ Each passes through the center of the other, so **distance between centers (d) = R**.

⇒ Length of **common chord (L)** = 16√3 cm.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/334201cd6fbc3e23ef1d48a22757b77d2966f638fb404a8e05b7b89e270f1597.png] 
**Property:** When two identical circles of radius **R** pass through each other's centers, the **line of centers** (O₁O₂) and the **common chord** (AC) bisect each other at **right angles**.

⇒ Let **M** be the midpoint of **O₁O₂**.

⇒ O₁M = R / 2

⇒ In right-angled triangle **ΔO₁MA**, by **Pythagoras Theorem**:

⇒ AM² = O₁A² − O₁M²

⇒ AM² = R² − (R / 2)²

⇒ AM² = R² − R² / 4 = 3R² / 4

⇒ AM = (R√3) / 2

⇒ Length of **common chord (AC)** = 2 × AM = R√3

⇒ Given AC = 16√3 cm

⇒ R√3 = 16√3

⇒ R = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Common Chord of Two Intersecting Circles

Length = 2 × √(R² − d₁²), where d₁ is the distance from the center to the chord.

Distance between centers

For identical circles passing through centers, the distance d = R. If they touch externally, d = 2R. If they touch internally, d = 0.

Area of Intersection

The overlapping area of two identical circles passing through each other's centers is given by R²(2π/3 − √3/2).</p
